title: Morning Deck card (bot intake format)
description: What a bot POSTs to /api/cards (one object, an array, or {"cards": [...]}) to put a question or FYI in the owner's morning deck. Gestures only RECORD an answer; the bot reads it back from GET /api/answers and acts on it itself.

id.description: Stable id used for dedupe. Recommended: "<bot>-<slug>-<YYYY-MM-DD>". Assigned by the server if missing. Re-posting an existing id is ignored (reported in `duplicates`). The prefix "morningdeck-" is reserved for Morning Deck's built-in cards (e.g. the daily feedback card morningdeck-feedback-YYYY-MM-DD, generated by the server, never posted by bots).

source.description: Bot display name, e.g. "Scheduler". GET /api/answers?source=<this> filters on it (case-insensitive).

sourceId.description: Optional stable bot id; ?source= also matches this.

type.description: question = yes/no, choice = custom labels per direction, info = FYI (right = Got it).

body.description: Short text shown on the card (clamped to ~6 lines).

details.description: Longer context shown only in the triple-tap sheet. Plain text, newlines preserved.

priority.description: Deck order: high first, then by createdAt (oldest first).

expiresAt.description: Card silently drops out of the deck after this time.

sample.description: true = example data; shown with a SAMPLE ribbon.

gestures.description: Per-card overrides merged over the type defaults. Omitted gestures keep their defaults.

replyTo.description: Opaque routing hint echoed back on every answer, e.g. {"channel":"slack","thread":"..."} or {"bot":"scheduler","task":"t_123"}. Morning Deck never acts on it.

label.description: Text on the edge hint, button and stamp.

value.description: Value recorded in the answer log. If you set a label but no value, the value becomes the slugged label (e.g. "Index fund" -> "index_fund").

prompt.description: tap3 only: placeholder/heading over the reply box.

snooze.description: If true the card is snoozed until the next 6:00 AM America/New_York instead of being closed. Default true only for the default up gesture (value "snooze").

disabled.description: Hide this direction for this card.

reply.description: Built-in cards only (ignored/not validated for bot cards): this direction opens the reply sheet first; Save records the gesture with optional text + photos.

attachment.title: Answer attachment (image)
attachment.description: An image added to a reply in the app. Uploaded with POST /api/uploads (max 8 MB, jpeg/png/webp/gif/avif/heic sniffed from magic bytes; the app downscales to <=1600px WebP/JPEG q0.85). Bots on this box can open `path` directly; `url` needs the Bearer token.

path.description: Absolute file path on the Morning Deck box: <data dir>/uploads/<id>.<ext>

answer.title: Answer log entry (GET /api/answers)
answer.description: What bots read back. Documentation only: bots don't send this. Replies (gesture tap3) carry text and/or attachments. Answers to the built-in feedback card have source "Morning Deck", replyTo {"bot":"morning-deck"} and builtin: true.
